verdict.rationale: Riveter is a web-scraping and enrichment API, so a proxy capability for hard-to-scrape sites is a fair question for it. The evidence documents scraping and extraction from "complicated websites" and AI agents that handle redesigns, but never mentions residential or datacenter proxies or any proxy configuration. Generic scraping claims are adjacent and do not count as proxy support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use premium residential or datacenter proxies to bypass sites that are hard to scrape
